spot.html_text: (iii) Pereira’s third type of movement is produced by training, which certain animals are capable of assimilating. His doctrine is developed through the exposition of specific cases of animal training. For example, Pereira considered the imitation of human language by birds as a special type of reflex mechanism in which hearing organs of birds receive voice waves which are transmitted to a soft area of the brain where they are recorded.
